description: Creates a folder owned by the user: at the top level, which only owners and admins of the organization may, or inside a folder the user owns or has manage on. Then file reports in it with updateReport's folderId, or create them there with createReport. Each call creates another folder, even with the same name.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

name.description: The folder's name, as members will see it in Rollstack. Leading and trailing spaces are removed, and it can't be blank.

parentFolderId.description: The folder to create it in, by its `id` from `listFolders`: one you own or have `manage` on. Omit it or pass `null` to create it at the top level, which only owners and admins of the organization may.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

name: createFolder
title: Create folder
